description: SHA-pinned fixtures for code-graph edge-level accuracy measurement. Every fixture must be at the pinned SHA before measurement; the harness exits 2 on drift. The `fixtures` array drives the syn-oracle path (compare.py + oracle_rust_syn.py / oracle_go_*.py). The `negative_fixtures` array is for hand-authored co-hallucination regression fixtures; those are evaluated independently by check_negative_fixtures.py with no syn-oracle in the loop.

fixtures.notes: Python-first fixture. Baseline: CALLS F1=0.981, IMPORTS F1=1.000 (scope-aligned).

Rust fixture on real redacted monorepo. Subset picked for structural variance: tiny pure-logic (canstatd 88 LOC) -> small async (calibd 184 LOC) -> monolithic (adsbd 631 LOC) -> large async-heavy (apid 6649 LOC, 52 files) -> macro/trait-heavy largest (assetman 20022 LOC, 118 files). Read-only per feedback memory.

Self-hosting Go fixture on code-graph itself. Originally planned psm/auth-gateway but that module has sqlc-generated types that aren't checked in, so Go RTA fails type-checking. code-graph is a ~90% Go codebase that type-checks cleanly. Subset picked for variance: store (SQLite CRUD), cypher (parser+executor), pipeline (multi-pass orchestrator), tools (MCP handlers), cbm (CGO bridge).

Non-self-hosting Go fixture (added 2026-05-02 per claude-knowledge-base PR #368 plateau-fix improvements). spf13/cobra at f2878ba — CLI-building library, ~10K LOC, 36 .go files, type-clean (no CGO, no generated code). Heavy receiver-method usage on the Command struct exercises Y.5 oracle resolver-method resolution. Self-hosting fixtures hit a ceiling where remaining residuals are oracle-specific limitations against the harness's own static analysis depth — adding a 2nd Go repo proves whether F1 generalizes outside the self-hosting case.

negative_fixtures.notes: Hand-authored fixture per 2026-05-02 roundtable Recommendation #1. Exercises the Diesel-chain co-hallucination class observed on assetman: external trait methods (.get_result/.load/.execute) chained on a query builder share bare names with internal methods on AssetRepo + IntrospectService. Evaluated by check_negative_fixtures.py against forbidden_emitted_calls in its ground_truth.json. Baseline phantom_count: 1 (see baselines/2026-05-02-diesel-negative-baseline.md). No SHA pinning — fixture lives in this repo and version-tracks with code-graph.
